blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A privacy evaluation of de-identified text asks a language model (the adversary) to guess a person's protected attribute. We introduce a prior-normalised clipped leakage score of its confidence gain on the true value and audit the conclusions drawn from it. Each verdict depends on an evaluation interface (the queried person, answer options, prior, adversary model and scoring rule), which we vary on fixed releases of three corpora. In a stress test, an editor that writes the opposite-sex form at the same spans a redaction editor would redact misleads the adversary about most people, yet ranks first among editors scored on the same MedQA entries under this score, as under attack accuracy and proper scoring rules read as privacy. A relabelling-invariant reading of AUC ranks that editor sixth of eight, and a rule-aware adversary recovers the attribute from the same text. On ordinary releases most verdict changes are gains or losses of separability; of six choices varied over all pairs, only the adversary reverses comparisons (5 of its 124 changes), and the query can target the wrong person. SACC, a traceable editor we build as the instrument, lets us ablate two editing principles and show where its advantage does not hold.
blocks.zh: 对去识别文本的隐私评价要求语言模型(对手)猜测一个人受保护的属性. 我们提出一个事先正常的漏损分数,说明它对真实价值的信心增益,并审计从中得出的结论。 每个判决都取决于一个评价界面(被询问人,答案选项,前期,对手模式和评分规则),我们对于固定释放3个军团有不同的看法. 在压力测试中,一个编辑在同一时间跨度写出异性表的编辑会编辑误导对手对大多数人的误导,然而,在同一份MedQA条目上得分的编辑中排名第一,在攻击准确度和正确评分规则下读作隐私。 对AUC的重贴标签-invariant读数将编辑器排在八位中的第六位,一个规则意识的对手从同一个文本中恢复属性. 在普通发布时,大多数判决的改变是可分离性的增减;在所有对子中,有6个选择不同,只有对手反向比较(其124个变化中的5个),查询可以针对错误的人. SACC,一个可追踪的编辑器,我们作为仪器建造,让我们放弃两项编辑原则,并显示其优势所在。

blocks.en: Privacy protection is essential for sharing and analysing text that describes people. Clinical narratives, legal records, and online posts support NLP research and applications, but can also expose sensitive information about the individuals involved. De-identification seeks to reduce this risk by removing explicit identifiers. Yet removing names and other direct identifiers is not enough: pronouns, kinship terms, and role nouns can still reveal sex, relationships, and occupation ( Lison et al., 2021 ; Pilán et al., 2022 ) . Language models can exploit these residual cues to infer personal attributes ( Staab et al., 2024 ; Oh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 隐私保护对于分享和分析描述人的文本至关重要。 临床叙事,法律记录,和在线帖子支持NLP的研究和应用,但也能够曝光有关相关个人的敏感信息. 消除身份识别试图通过删除明确的识别特征来减少这种风险。 然而删除名字和其他直接识别符是不够的:代词,亲缘关系术语,角色名词仍然可以揭示性别,关系和职业(Lison等人,2021年;Pilán等人,2022年). 语言模型可以利用这些剩余提示推断个人属性(Staab等人,2024年;Oh等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Evaluating whether de-identification actually protects those attributes is therefore consequential. Inference-based privacy evaluations use an adversary language model’s predictions on released text to compare editing methods. However, when a score credits only increased confidence in the true value, an edit that confidently misleads the adversary can appear more private even if attribute information remains recoverable. An evaluation can then favour the wrong edit, not because the text reveals less, but because its scoring rule mistakes misdirection for information removal.
blocks.zh: 因此,评估去识别是否实际保护了这些属性是必然的。 基于推论的隐私评价使用敌对语言模型对发布文本的预测来比较编辑方法. 然而,当得分记分只会增强对真实值的信心时,即使属性信息仍然可以被收回,但自信地误导对手的编辑会显得更加私人化. 然后评价可以偏向错误的编辑,不是因为文本显示得更少,而是因为它的评分规则错误地用于删除信息.

blocks.en: To systematically examine this scoring dependence, we introduce the clipped leakage score L L , a prior-normalised measure of gold-value confidence gain (Section 3 ). For each annotated entry, L L measures the increase in the probability of the true value over a document-free prior, normalised by the remaining distance to certainty and clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ; scores are balanced across annotation strata and attributes, so that no subgroup dominates.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地审查这种积分依赖性,我们引入了被剪切的漏损得分LL,这是对黄金价值信心增益的预先正常衡量(第3节)。 对于每个附加说明的条目,L度测量真实值的概率大于一个没有文档的前置值的概率,通过剩余距离到确定性的正常化,并剪切到[0,1] [0,1];分数在注释层和属性之间是平衡的,因此没有子组占主导地位.

blocks.en: Beyond the scoring rule, the scorer chooses a person reference, candidate answers and their order, a document-free prior, and an adversary model; together, these choices form the evaluation interface . We ask how far a privacy verdict for a fixed released text changes when the interface, rather than the text, changes (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在评分规则之外,计分员选择一个人的参考,候选人的答案和他们的顺序,一个没有文档的前身,以及一个对手模式;这些选择一起构成评价界面. . 我们询问,当界面而不是文本发生变化时,固定释放文本的隐私判断会改变多少(表1)。

blocks.en: Our first test targets the one-sidedness of L L . SWAP is a deliberately invertible counterexample: it replaces sex cues with opposite-sex forms at exactly the spans a redaction editor would remove (Figure 1 ). On MedQA, SWAP attains the lowest L L among editors scored on the same entries, while it misleads the adversary on 74% of its Sex entries. By | AUC − .5 | |\mathrm{AUC}-.5| , it ranks only sixth of eight. In a post hoc rule-aware test on 1,513 MedQA Sex entries, informing the adversary of the swap rule raises its mean gold-value probability from .252 to .769. The issue is not confined to L L : attack accuracy and proper scoring rules can also reward misdirection when read as privacy (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的首个测试目标 片面LL。 SWAP是一个故意不可逆的反例:它用异性形式代替性提示,精确的跨度是编辑器会删除的(图1). 在《医疗质量评估》中,全系统行动计划在同一条目上获得的编辑分数中最低的LL,同时在74%的性别条目上误导对手。 由 QQ AUC − 5 → QQ mathrm{AUC } - 5 → 排名八强中仅列第六位. 在对1,513个MedQA Sex条目进行事后规则意识测试时,告知对手互换规则,其平均黄金值概率从252提高到769。 问题不仅限于LL:攻击精确度和适当的评分规则也可以在读作隐私时奖励错误方向(第4节)。

blocks.en: We next re-score fixed releases from three corpora—MedQA clinical vignettes, TAB court judgments, and SynthPAI social-media posts—varying evaluation choices one at a time under three adversary families (Section 5 ). Across 988 contrasts between released texts, most changed verdicts gain or lose statistical separability without reversing a comparison’s direction: the adversary family changes 124 of 504 verdicts, and only five reverse. Thus, stable rankings do not guarantee stable statistical evidence that two releases differ on the stated leakage score. Of the six protocol choices in Figure 3 , only the adversary family reverses comparisons. Separate analyses identify reversals from attribute aggregation and from a text-conditioned prior confounded with redaction; a cue-deletion prior free of that confound changes separability but not direction (Section 5 ; Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 接下来我们从三只蝎子重新获得固定释放 MedQA临床广告、TAB法庭判决和SynthPAI社会媒体文章——在三个对峙家庭之下,一次一次有变化的评价选择(第5节)。 在988年之间,在公布的文本之间形成对比,大多数变更的判决是在不颠倒比较方向的情况下获得或失去统计分离性的:对手家庭在504个判决中改变124个,只有5个相反。 因此,稳定的排名不能保证稳定的统计证据,即两种释放在所述渗漏分数上有所不同。 在图3中的6个协议选择中,只有对手家庭反向比较. 单独分析从属性汇总和文字条件事先与编辑的混淆中找出倒置;在删除前标出一个提示,而不包括混淆的变动可分离性而不是方向(第5节;附录E)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are fourfold. First, we introduce L L , which operationalises one-sided gold-value confidence gain. Second, we identify and demonstrate a misdirection failure through a controlled counterexample, alternative scoring rules, and a rule-aware recovery test. Third, we audit evaluation-interface sensitivity on fixed releases, distinguishing direction reversals from changes in separability, supported by SACC (Scoped Attribute-Cue Closure), a traceable editor that makes SWAP and separate ablations of two editing principles possible (Section 6 ). Fourth, we derive a failure-driven reporting checklist covering misdirection, subject-reference errors, adversary sensitivity, and statistical uncertainty (Section 7 ). We release texts, per-entry scores, and code. 1 1 1 Code, released texts, and per-entry scores are available from the authors.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有四倍。 首先,我们介绍L L, 它操作 片面的黄金价值信心收益。 其次,我们通过控制反例、替代评分规则和规则意识恢复测试,确定并证明误向失败。 第三,我们在SACC(缩小属性-Cue Close)的支持下,对固定发行版的评价与界面敏感性进行审计,区分方向逆转和可分离性的变化,这是可追踪的编辑器,使全系统行动计划和两个编辑原则的单独拼写成为可能(第6节)。 第四,我们得出了一个由故障驱动的报告核对表,涵盖错误方向、主题参考错误、敌方敏感性和统计不确定性(第7节)。 我们发布文本,每进分数和代码。 11 代码,发布文本,每进分数 可以从作者那里得到。

blocks.en: We introduce L L as an analytical measure that isolates prior-normalised, one-sided confidence gain on the gold value. It is intended for controlled evaluation audits rather than as a comprehensive measure of attribute recoverability. Subject-level evaluation reports the share of personal attributes an adversary fails to infer, pooled over people (CPR) or averaged per person (IPR) ( Oh et al., 2026 ) ; attack accuracy counts top-1 correctness; proper scoring rules score a whole predictive distribution ( Brier, 1950 ; Gneiting and Raftery, 2007 ) ; AUC measures discrimination, and | AUC − .5 | |\mathrm{AUC}-.5| is unchanged when the labels are exchanged. Crediting only the increase above a document-free prior charges a release for what it adds rather than for what the adversary already guessed; the risk is the other half, where a drop below the prior costs nothing. Our stress test targets that one property, which attack accuracy and proper scoring rules on the gold value share when their prediction errors are read as privacy (Section 4 ). L L is distinct from CPR and IPR, whose validity we do not assess.
blocks.zh: 我们采用LL作为分析措施,把黄金价值的事先正常、片面信心收益隔离开来。 它旨在进行有控制的评价审计,而不是作为属性可回收性的全面衡量标准。 主题一级的评价报告说,对手的个人属性份额未能推断、集合在人身上(CPR)或人均(IPR)(Oh等人,2026年);攻击精度计数为最高-1正确;适当的评分规则得分为整个预测分布(Brier,1950年;Gneiting和Rafty,2007年);AUC衡量歧视,在交换标签时,AUC− 5 |\ mathrm{AUC}- 5|没有变化。 仅将超过无文件前期费用的增加额计入其增加额的释放额,而不是计入对手已经猜到的;风险是另一半,即低于前期成本的下降额。 我们的压力测试目标是,当预测错误被解读为隐私时,一个财产攻击金价份额的准确性和适当的评分规则(第4节)。 LL不同于国家方案建议和投资政策审查,我们不评估其有效性。

blocks.en: A ranking depends on what its score credits: membership-inference attacks rank differently under average-case and low-false-positive-rate metrics ( Carlini et al., 2022 ) , and anonymisation has been judged by information-theoretic criteria, by re-identification attacks and by quantitative information flow ( Sánchez and Batet, 2016 ; Manzanares-Salor et al., 2024 ; Smith, 2009 ; Alvim et al., 2012 ) . Multiverse and specification-curve analyses vary defensible analytic choices ( Steegen et al., 2016 ; Simonsohn et al., 2020 ) ; because our choices change what is estimated and on which entries, we analyse each separately. Like Mozes and Kleinberg (2021) , we ask whether an evaluation measures what it claims to, adding judge controls, bootstrap intervals, multiple-comparison corrections ( Krippendorff, 2004 ; Efron and Tibshirani, 1993 ; Holm, 1979 ) and answer-position checks ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ) ; none of this work varies the interface while the released text is held fixed.
blocks.zh: 排名取决于它的得分:成员推论攻击在平均和低假阳性衡量标准下排名不同(Carlini等人,2022年),匿名化是根据信息理论标准、重新识别攻击和定量信息流来判断的(Sánchez和Batet,2016年;Manzanares-Salor等人,2024年;Smith,2009年;Alvim等人,2012年)。 多向和规格曲线分析有不同的可论证的分析选择(Steegen等人,2016年;Simonsohn等人,2020年),因为我们的选择改变了估计值和条目,我们各自分别分析。 与Mozes和Kleinberg(2021年)一样,我们问评估是否衡量它所声称的,增加法官控制、靴子间隔、多比校正(Krippendorff,2004年;Efron和Tibshirani,1993年;Holm,1979年)和回答位置检查(Zheng等人,2024年;Pezeshkpour和Hruschka,2024年);没有一项工作改变接口,而公布的文本是固定的。

blocks.en: Language models infer personal attributes from ordinary text ( Staab et al., 2024 ) , extending classifier-based attacks ( Mosallanezhad et al., 2019 ; Elazar and Goldberg, 2018 ) . Oh et al. (2026) evaluate anonymisation per person; we follow that framing and reuse their annotated TAB documents with our own scorer (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 语言模型从普通文本中推断个人属性(Staab等人,2024年),扩展基于分类器的攻击 (Mosallanezhad等人,2019年;Elazar和Goldberg,2018年). Oh等人(2026年)对每人的匿名性进行评估;我们遵循这一规定,用自己的计分器来制定和重新使用附加说明的TAB文件(第3节)。

blocks.en: Span-based de-identification masks or generalises identifiers ( Lison et al., 2021 ; Pilán et al., 2022 ) . Language-model anonymisers rewrite under adversarial feedback ( Staab et al., 2025 ) , replace spans truthfully ( Pilán et al., 2025 ) , optimise prompts ( Loiseau et al., 2026 ) , or randomise the protected attribute ( Frikha et al., 2025 ) . Randomisation matters here because, whenever the random value is wrong, a score that floors losses at zero credits it as it credits SWAP, though a random value cannot be undone by a known rule. Appendix F surveys further related work.
blocks.zh: 泛基脱识别面具或通用识别标志 (Lison等人,2021年;Pilán等人,2022年). 语言模型匿名者在对抗性反馈下重写(Staab等人,2025年),真实替换(Pilán等人,2025年),优化提示(Loiseau等人,2026年),或随机分配受保护属性(Frikha等人,2025年)。 随机化在这里很重要,因为每当随机值错误时,一个分数在计入全部门办法时以零入计损失,尽管随机值不能被已知规则所抵消。 附录F调查了进一步的相关工作。

blocks.en: The editors we compare perform one task. Given an anonymised document D D , protected subjects S S with the mention forms M ⁡ ( s ) M(s) by which D D refers to each, and attribute names A A , find the residual cues —spans whose surface form states a value of some a ∈ A a\in A for some person—and return D ′ D^{\prime} , with edits confined to those spans and the grammatical agreement they disturb. Three requirements define a good edit: privacy , an adversary reading D ′ D^{\prime} about s s should end no better off than with no text, neither more confident in the true value nor steered towards a wrong one; utility , content stating no protected attribute of a protected subject should survive; scope , cues bound to people outside S S , and attribute words naming no person, should be left alone. These are desiderata, not guarantees: the evaluation tests whether they hold under a stated adversary and scorer (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: Each editor maps the anonymised input to a released text. Global mask redacts every match in a shared lexicon of attribute words, whoever the word describes; the global ladder replaces each match with a broader term. SACC follows two principles. Default-deny closure : fixed word lists propose cues and a rule-based binder uses a dependency parse to decide whom each describes—a protected person (directly or through a relation word, husband in her husband ), a person it cannot identify (unresolved), someone else, or no person—and a cue is edited unless the binder assigns it to someone else (the other-person rule ) or to no person (the non-person rule ). Unresolved cues matter because de-identification often removes the name a binder would need. Admissible rewriting : a selected cue becomes a value-neutral counterpart from a fixed table ( he → \to they ), or is redacted when the table has none, and a repair step fixes verb agreement (the only tuned setting). SACC-mask keeps the selection and redacts throughout. blocks.en: Three properties of the question can distort these scores. Without a document, binary answers often follow option position, so removing a cue can move the gold probability off the prior without the text stating any value; we therefore also report Sex AUC, the probability that the adversary rates a male person as more likely male than a female one, which its default answer cannot shift. An editor that paraphrases can delete the mentions a reference relies on, so when comparing paraphrasing with in-place editors we use entries where both yield the same reference. In documents describing several people the adversary may answer from another person’s cues, so we also split off each document’s first-named subject.

blocks.en: In TAB’s anonymised input, Sex AUC is .98 for each judgment’s first-named person but .32 for others, whose predicted sex follows the first-named person’s (post hoc; Table 25 ). An AUC of .32 is consistent with systematic misattribution: pooling both groups yields .53, which reflects neither, and an editor that moves .32 toward .5 would appear to increase discrimination. In 73 of 244 TAB Sex entries the reference also matches another person (Appendix I ); excluding them increases the input–SACC reduction in Sex L L , and all comparisons keep their sign. Matched references also matter: when all editors share one reference, Adaptive’s MedQA advantage shrinks from .054 to a non-separable .024 (on texts before a fix to the binder, and still not separable after it; Appendix R ). On identical texts, a shared reference changes only verdicts involving Adaptive (3 of its 24; Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: The verdict also changes with the attributes the score averages. MedQA’s Occupation placeholders are hard to interpret (Section 3 ), and on Sex alone two contrasts reverse sign: the LLM rewrite, separably more private than SACC on the pre-specified endpoint, leaks more ( + .039 +.039 ), as does Adaptive ( + .051 +.051 ; Table 3 ). We keep the pre-specified endpoint and report both readings rather than promoting the narrower one after seeing the result (Table 44 ); which attributes are averaged is itself an interface choice.
blocks.zh: 判决也随着分数平均值的属性而变化. MedQA的职业占位符很难解释(第3节 ) , 仅仅在性别上,有两个反向符号:LLM重写,在预先指定的终点上比SCAC更私密,泄露的更多(+.039+.039 ) , 适应性(+.051+.051 ;表3 ) 也是如此。 我们保留预先指定的终点,并报告两种读数,而不是在看到结果后促进更窄的(表44 ) ; 平均的属性本身就是接口选择。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluating SACC
blocks.zh: 6 评价小武器管制中心

blocks.en: SACC is the traceable controlled editor that made the releases above possible; we now ask what its two principles contribute, and under which adversaries and corpora its advantage holds.
blocks.zh: SACC是可追踪的控制编辑器,使上述发布成为可能;我们现在问其两项原则有何贡献,以及它的优势在于哪些对手和公司。

blocks.en: Table 4: What each principle contributes , under the development adversary. Positive Δ ​ L \Delta L : the change lowers leakage (99% intervals); positive Δ ​ U nli \Delta U_{\mathrm{nli}} : it keeps more content (95%); bold excludes 0. Indented: the selection’s two rules; rows do not add (Table 11 ).

blocks.en: Ablations vary one principle at a time (Table 4 ). The privacy gain sits in closure: editing only the cues the binder assigns to a protected person leaks more by .079 on MedQA and .122 on TAB. It matters because 41% of MedQA and 90% of TAB edited cues are unresolved, and a judge reading the source text assigns 97.5% of unresolved TAB sites to protected people. Admissible rewriting lowers L L over redaction by .024 and .022, keeps more MedQA content ( U nli + .041 U_{\mathrm{nli}}{}+.041 ) and leaves fewer MedQA Sex entries Misled ( − .031 -.031 ; Appendix O ), but that privacy gain is reproduced by Qwen and not by Llama (Appendix K ), so rewriting is mainly a content choice that can be dropped at little worst-case privacy cost. Scoping the selection is not itself a privacy gain: against global selection with the same rewrite step, SACC’s selection is .010 less private on MedQA and not separable on TAB, where it keeps more content. Of its two rules, the non-person rule buys content rather than privacy and the other-person rule moves neither measurably, so we do not claim that subject awareness lowers leakage.
blocks.zh: 一项原则不一(表4)。 隐私收益坐落于关闭中:只编辑绑定器分配给受保护者的提示,在MedQA和TAB上分别以0.079和0.122泄露更多. 这很重要,因为41%的MedQA和90%的TAB编辑提示尚未解决,阅读源文本的法官将97.5%的未解决的TAB网站分配给受保护的人。 允许重写 L L 超过 编辑 0.024 和 0.022 保留更多的 MeDQA 内容(U nli + .041 U_{\mathrm{nli}}{}+.041),并留下较少的 MeDQA 性别条目 误写(− 031 - 031;附录 O),但隐私收益由 Quen 而不是 Llama (Appendix K ) 复制,因此重写主要是一个内容选择,可以以微小最差的隐私成本放弃. 限定选择范围本身并不是隐私收益:与采用相同重写步骤的全球选择相比,SCAC的选择在MedQA上是0.010的私密,在TAB上是不能分开的,它保留了更多的内容. 在它的两个规则中,非人规则购买内容而不是隐私,而另一人规则的动作也都不是可以衡量的,所以我们并不声称这个主题意识会降低渗漏.

blocks.en: The other-person rule is the only one that reads the subject list, and since nearly every annotated person here is protected, it changes no measure. Judged against the source text on TAB it is right on .32 of the sites it keeps, leaving 2.1 protected persons’ sites unedited for each one it correctly withholds (Appendix N ). Scope is thus a release policy a deployment can switch off, not a privacy mechanism. Applied unchanged to 500 biographies ( De-Arteaga et al., 2019 ) and 500 plot summaries ( Bamman et al., 2013 ) , SACC lowers input leakage by .35 and .11 while editing the fewest characters; but these corpora name many unprotected people, and there the global ladder leaks less, by .030 and .089 (Appendix N ), because it edits their cues too.
blocks.zh: 另一人规则是唯一一个读取主题列表的规则,由于这里几乎每个注解人物都受到保护,它不会改变任何措施. 对TAB上的来源文本作出判断,它所保存的32个地点是正确的,保留了2.1个受保护人地点未经编辑,每一处地方都正确保留(附录N)。 因此,范围是释放政策,部署可以关闭,而不是隐私机制。 适用于500个传记(De-Arteaga等人,2019年)和500个情节摘要(Bamman等人,2013年),SCAC在编辑最少的字符时降低了35和11个输入渗漏;但这些蝎子命名了许多没有保护的人,全球阶梯的渗漏较少,只有0.030和0.89(附录N),因为它也编辑了他们的提示.

blocks.en: SACC reduces L L , Leaking and Disclosing relative to its anonymised input on both corpora (Table 3 ); under the seeded reading TAB’s Leaking reduction is the one verdict that is not separable (Appendix I ). L L falls by .207 on MedQA and .145 on TAB, about a quarter of the input score in each corpus (intervals in Table 27 ). Part of the fall is displacement: of the .274 drop in MedQA Sex Leaking (seeded orders), .174 moves entries into the band and .101 below it, and every editor but INTACT leaves .24–.28 of entries Misled , the input .14 (Appendix O ). Most gains come from Sex , where AUC also falls (Table 3 ; on TAB post hoc). The MedQA Sex reduction remains separable under both held-out adversaries, as does TAB’s under Qwen (Appendix K ). On MedQA exam questions, GPT-4o-mini is equally accurate on SACC’s text and on the anonymised input (73.0%), with no measurable change under any editor (Appendix Q ).
blocks.zh: SACC减少L L, 泄漏和断裂量, 相对于其在两个蝎子上的匿名输入(表3); 在种子读数中, TAB 的漏损减少是一个不可分离的判决(附录一)。 LL在MedQA和TAB上分别下降了207分和145分,约占每本书输入分数的四分之一(表27的间隔)。 部分掉落是流离失所:在MedQA Sex Leaking(种子订单)的274个下降中,174个条目移入波段,下面为0.101个,除INTACT外,每个编辑都留下24–28个条目Misled,输入14(附录O). 大部分收益来自性,而哥伦比亚联合自卫军也降级(表3;关于临时行政局)。 MedQA的性减少在两个被搁置的对手中仍然是分开的,在Quen(附录K)下的TAB也是如此。 关于MedQA考试问题,GPT-4o-mini对SCAC的文本和匿名输入同样准确(73.0%),在任何编辑器(附录Q)下都没有可衡量的变化.

blocks.en: Under the rule-unaware development adversary, global mask leaks more than SACC on MedQA, while the global ladder is narrowly equivalent within ± .02 \pm.02 on the three MedQA privacy measures (two one-sided tests; Appendix B ). SACC is more private than INTACT on both corpora and than Adaptive on TAB. On MedQA, Adaptive trades content for privacy: Edit% 51.7 vs. 1.3, and about one-third less content ( U nli U_{\mathrm{nli}} .467 vs. .706). Its lower L L ( − - .054) is not separable once both share one reference, because its paraphrase deletes the patient’s mention; on Sex alone it leaks more ( + .051 +.051 ; Table 3 ). On TAB SACC edits about one-third fewer sites than the ladder with higher TPS ( + .043 +.043 ), and blind annotators judge it to keep more content than the ladder and SACC-mask, by .24 and .04 on a 0–2 scale, though not more grammatical (Appendix W ).
blocks.zh: 在规则-unaware开发对手下,全球面具在MedQA上的泄露量超过SCAC,而全球阶梯在±.02\pm.02范围内在MedQA的三项隐私措施(两个单面测试;附录B)上微弱等效. SACC对公司来说比INTACT更私人,对TAB来说也更适应. 在MedQA上,适应性交易内容为隐私:编辑% 51.7 vs. 1.3,并减少约三分之一的内容(Unli U_{\ mathrm{nli}}-467 vs.706)。 它的低L(−-054)一旦共享一个参考,就无法分离,因为它的引文删除了病人的提及;仅仅在性问题上,它就泄露更多(+.051 +.051;表3 ) 。 在TAB SACC上,比高TPS(+.043 +.043)的阶梯编辑大约少三分之一的站点,盲人的注释者判断它保存的内容比阶梯和SACC-mask要多,比0.24和0.04比0.2的阶梯和SACC-mask要少三分之一(Appendix W ).

blocks.en: SACC is deterministic, reads neither the source text nor a gold value, and traces each edit to its rule, which let Section 4 build SWAP at the sites SACC-mask redacts. Edits stay inside cue spans and the agreement they disturb, whereas the LLM rewrite changes an upstream placeholder in 10.4% of MedQA and 16.5% of TAB documents. SACC calls no language model: 0.17 s per MedQA document on one CPU core (Appendices G and H ).
blocks.zh: SACC是决定性的,既不读出源文本,也不读出黄金值,每部编辑都追踪到它的规则,这让第4节在SACC-mask编辑站点建立全部门办法。 编辑停留在提示间距内,并干扰协议,而LLM重写在MedQA文件的10.4%和TAB文件的16.5%。 SACC称没有语言模型: 0. 17 s 在一个CPU核心(附录G和H)上的每个 MeDQA文件.

blocks.en: 7 What to Report
blocks.zh: 页:1 报告内容

blocks.en: Four things belong beside any leakage score. Score : report L L with two-sided displacement and, where applicable, AUC, and explain any disagreement (e.g., SWAP, Table 2 ); where an editor’s rule is public, run a rule-aware adversary too. Reference and cohort : give paraphrasing and in-place editors the same reference, and report first-named and other subjects separately. Adversary and abstention : report every adversary used, including any that reverses a result, say whether it knows the editing rule, and report both conventions for declined answers. Uncertainty and content : separate reversals from changes in separability, give each non-separable comparison’s minimum detectable difference, and validate content measures.
blocks.zh: 除了漏水分数之外还有四样东西 得分:报告LL有两面性迁移,并在适用的情况下,哥伦比亚联合自卫军,并解释任何不同意见(例如全系统行动计划,表2);如果编辑的规则是公开的,则还要有一个了解规则的对手。 参考文献和群组:给同名参考文献和现场编辑提供参考文献,并分别报告第一题和其他课题。 反面和弃权:报告所使用的每个对手,包括任何逆转结果的对手,说明它是否了解编辑规则,并报告两个公约都被拒绝的答复。 不确定性和内容:从可分离性的变化中分离出逆转,给予每个不可分离的比较最小可察觉的差异,并验证内容计量.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Privacy verdicts depend on the evaluation interface. SWAP ranks first by clipped leakage and attack accuracy on MedQA under a rule-unaware adversary but sixth of eight by | AUC − .5 | |\mathrm{AUC}-.5| , and, told the swap rule, that adversary recovers the attribute for most entries. Clipping hides how far confidence falls, and reading failed prediction as privacy rewards misdirection. On ordinary releases most verdict changes concern separability; of the six choices in Figure 3 , only the adversary reverses comparisons (5 of its 124 changes). Separate analyses find reversals from attribute aggregation and a redaction-confounded prior, not from a confound-free cue-deletion prior. A privacy claim can be interpreted only together with its protocol.
blocks.zh: 隐私判决取决于评价界面. SWAP在规则-不知情的对手下,首先通过剪切渗漏和攻击精确度对MedQA进行排名,但在8项中的第6项则由QQAUC − 5 { mathrm{AUC}- 5| }进行排名。 Clipping隐藏信心下降多深,将失败预测读作隐私奖励错误方向. 在普通发布时,大多数判决变更涉及可分离性;在图3中的六个选择中,只有对手反向比较(124个修改中的5个)。 单独分析可以发现属性集合的反转,以及先前的重新编译依据,而不是之前的混沌无线索删除。 隐私要求只能与协议一起解释。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: SWAP exposes a mismatch in pipelines that read a stated adversary’s failed prediction as privacy; it does not make the Brier score or log loss invalid measures of prediction, nor show that every subject-level privacy metric shares the weakness. It is a single invertible construction: its rule-aware recovery result pertains to that rule and an adversary told it, and a randomised, secret or non-invertible editor needs its own attacker model and recovery test; the AUC reading, which needs no rule, is interpretable on MedQA and, with wide intervals, on TAB’s first-named subjects only. Disclosing measures two-sided belief displacement, not attribute recoverability. For multi-class attributes, Misled marks a drop below the prior rather than confidence in an incorrect value. The protocol choices we vary change which entries are scored, so Figure 3 summarises their effects descriptively, and the ablation rows of Table 4 hold different things fixed, so they are not one path and do not add. All claims concern a multiple-choice scorer that is instructed which person to consider (Appendix M ) on English corpora, each with a single upstream de-identifier.
blocks.zh: SWAP暴露了管道中的不匹配现象,将一个被宣称的对手的失败预测读作隐私;它并没有使Brier得分或日志损失的预测计量无效,也没有表明每个主题层面的隐私度量表都与弱点相同. 它是一个单一的不可逆的构思:其规则意识的恢复结果与该规则有关,对手告诉它,随机的,秘密的或非不可逆的编辑需要自己的攻击者模型和恢复测试;不需要规则的AUC读法在MedQA上可以解释,而且间隔很广,只能解释TAB的第一题。 隔离措施是双面的信仰转移,而不是属性可恢复。 对于多类属性,Misled标记了低于先前而不是对不正确值的信心的下降. 协议选择我们更改了哪些条目被打入,所以图3以描述性的方式概括了它们的效果,表4的衰减行持有不同的事物固定,所以它们不是一条路径,也不添加. 所有索赔都涉及一个多选择计分器,该计分器被指示在英语corpora上由谁考虑(Appendix M ),每个计分器都有一个上游去识别器.

blocks.en: Main claims rely on one development adversary, a proprietary API whose outputs drift between sessions and which also produced MedQA’s gold labels (Appendix I ); the held-out adversaries are smaller than some used in earlier attack studies ( Staab et al., 2024 ) . Some of SACC’s results do not hold under every adversary: on TAB, its reduction of input leakage and the gain of rewriting over redaction fail under Llama and GPT-4.1-mini without reasoning, and the closure gain is untested beyond the development adversary (Appendices K and R ). When given the editors’ rules, the development adversary ranks the global ladder ahead of SACC on MedQA, contrary to our pre-specified prediction (Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 主要索赔依赖于一个开发对手,一个专有的API,其产出在会间漂移,还生产了MedQA的金色标签(附录一);被搁置的对手比以前攻击研究中使用的对手小(Staab等人,2024年)。 SACC的某些结果并不代表每个对手:在TAB方面,在Llama和GPT-4.1-mini之下,减少输入渗漏和重写编辑收益在Llama和GPT-4.1-mini之下失败,关闭收益在发展对手之外没有经过测试(附录K和R)。 与我们事先确定的预测(附录L)相反,

blocks.en: TAB’s 144 documents cannot detect differences below about .04 to .09 (Table 28 ), so null results reflect limited power. L L excludes high-prior entries and is not a population risk measure, and which Sex entries are eligible depends on seeded candidate orders, a selection that balancing does not repair. Automatic content measures ignore grammaticality; human judges observed agreement errors after rewriting, and SACC failed its pre-specified grammar test against SACC-mask (Appendix W ).
blocks.zh: TAB的144份文件无法探测到大约在0.04至0.09以下的差异(表28),因此,无效的结果反映出权力有限。 LL排除了高优先入选,不是人口风险衡量标准,哪些性别入选资格取决于种子候选人的订单,这种选择不能弥补平衡. 自动内容度量法忽略了语法性;人类法官在重写后观察到协议错误,而SCAC对SACC-mask(Appendix W.)的预设语法测试失败.

blocks.en: SACC edits lexically stated evidence—primarily grammatical sex marking—using lexicons written on the evaluation corpora. Contextual evidence remains, and an LLM rewrite removes more of it: it leaks less than SACC on MedQA’s reported score under the development adversary, and by point estimate but not separably under the held-out families, though more on Sex alone (Table 44 ). On these benchmarks, SACC’s gains come from closure and admissible rewriting, while the rule that preserves other people’s cues (the other-person rule) has no measurable privacy effect; on the two new corpora, which name many unprotected people, the global ladder leaks less (Appendices G and N ). In languages with grammatical gender, fewer rewrites would be admissible and more cues would be redacted.
blocks.zh: SACC使用评价公司上书写的词汇来编辑逻辑上陈述的证据——主要是语法上的性标记。 根据发展对手的MedQA报告得分, 在这些基准上,SCAC的收益来自于关闭和可接受重写,而保留他人暗示的规则(另一人规则)并没有可衡量的隐私影响;对于两个新公司,它命名了许多没有保护的人,全球梯子漏得更少(附录G和N)。 在具有语法性别的语文中,可以修改的文字较少,而且会编辑更多的提示。

blocks.en: Some feminine pronouns remain redacted more often than masculine ones, and when the other-person rule leaves a cue, a reader who knows the rule can infer that a person is unprotected; disabling the rule closes this channel (Appendix G ). Forms outside the lexicon, such as Mx. or neopronouns, pass unedited, so people who use them can become more distinguishable after editing; this cost falls on an already marginalised group ( Lauscher et al., 2022 ) . A deployment should add the forms used by its population.
blocks.zh: 一些女性代名词仍然比男性代名词更经常地被修改,当他人规则留下提示时,了解规则的读者可以推断一个人没有保护;使规则失效会关闭这个频道(Appendix G ). 词汇表以外的形式,如Mx.或新代词,通过未经编辑的,因此使用它们的人在编辑后可以更加区分;这一成本落在已经被边缘化的群体身上(Lauscher等人,2022年). 部署应增加其居民使用的表格。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We use public datasets under their licences: MedQA (MIT), TAB (MIT; published judgments of the European Court of Human Rights), SynthPAI (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; synthetic), and the two transfer corpora in Appendix N . Our editor and scoring code are released under the MIT licence; derived texts and scores retain the corpora’s applicable licences. A script recomputes the main tables from the per-entry scores and dated run records we release. We collect no new personal data, attempt no re-identification, and query adversaries only about attributes the benchmarks already annotate. The attack follows prior attribute-inference work ( Staab et al., 2024 ) ; our contribution is a way to detect when a score overstates the privacy of a release.
blocks.zh: 我们使用其许可证下的公共数据集:MedQA(MIT)、TAB(MIT;欧洲人权法院公布的判决)、SynthPAI(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0;合成)和附录N中的两家转移公司。 我们的编辑和评分代码根据麻省理工学院的许可发布;衍生的文本和评分保留了公司适用的许可. 一个脚本从每个输入的分数中重新计算主表格,以及我们发布的日期运行记录. 我们没有收集新的个人数据,没有尝试重新识别,只询问对手已经说明的基准属性。 攻击遵循了之前的属性推论工作(Staab等人,2024年);我们的贡献是用来检测得分是否过度夸大了释放的隐私.

blocks.en: SWAP attributes false sex values to the people its texts describe. We built it because a leaderboard based on clipped leakage alone would reward such misdescription, and randomising the protected attribute is already a published anonymisation strategy ( Frikha et al., 2025 ) . We distribute SWAP only as evaluation code, not as an anonymiser.
blocks.zh: 全部门办法将虚假的性价值归结于其文本所描述的人。 我们建造它是因为一个仅基于剪切的渗漏的领袖板会奖励这种错误描述,随机化受保护的属性已经是一个已公布的匿名化战略(Frikha等人,2025年)。 我们只把全部门办法作为评价准则,而不是作为匿名者分发。

blocks.en: SACC does not guarantee privacy: evidence outside its lexicon or across releases may remain inferable, and its rules reveal which forms it cannot rewrite (Limitations), although an adversary given the rules infers less, not more, from every edited MedQA text except SWAP’s (Appendix L ). Rewriting gendered expressions is a policy choice, and clinical use was not evaluated. The binary Sex labels follow the datasets and do not imply that sex or gender is binary.

blocks.en: Appendix A The Task and the Editor in Full
blocks.zh: 附录A 任务和完全编辑器

blocks.en: Given protected subjects and attribute names, identify and edit residual cues in an anonymised document. The reported releases use a shared protected-attribute set for listed subjects. Although detection can in principle gate cues at the subject–attribute level, edit decisions in this work are aggregated by attribute, and heterogeneous policies are not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 在匿名文档中识别和编辑剩余提示。 报告的释放使用了一套针对所列主体的共享保护属性。 虽然原则上可以在主题属性层面进行检测,但这项工作中的编辑决定是按属性汇总的,不评价各种政策。

blocks.en: An upstream de-identifier produces a document D D in which identifying spans are replaced by typed placeholders. The editor receives D D , a set of protected subjects S S , mention forms M ⁡ ( s ) M(s) by which the text may refer to each s ∈ S s\in S , and a set of attribute names A A . S S contains the people designated in our panel (1,793 in the 1,249 MedQA vignettes; 586 in the 144 TAB judgments), not every person mentioned. In our corpora A = { Sex , Occupation , Relationship } A=\{\textsc{Sex},\textsc{Occupation},\textsc{Relationship}\} ; Relationship enters the primary measure on SynthPAI only (Section 3 ). Mention forms are those maintained by a release pipeline for the people it protects. The editor does not access the source text or any gold attribute value.
blocks.zh: 一个上游去标识符生成一个文件D D,其中的标识跨度被打入的占位符所取代. 编辑收到D,一组保护对象 S S, 提及表格 M ⁡(s) M(s), 文本可以指每个 s ∈ S s\ in S, 以及一组属性名称 A. S 包含我们板上指定的人员(1,793名在1,249 MedQA vignettes;586名在144 TAB判决中), 并非每个被提及的人. 在我们的A = { 性,职业,关系 } A = textsc{ Sex},\ textsc{ Occupation},\ textsc{关系 }; 关系只进入合成派伊的主要衡量标准(第3节). 提到的表格是为其保护的人提供的释放管道所维护的表格。 编辑器不访问源文本或任何金属性值.

blocks.en: A residual cue is a span c = ( i , j , a ) c=(i,j,a) of D D whose surface form states a value of attribute a ∈ A a\in A for some entity: a gendered pronoun or form of address for Sex , a kinship or marital term for Relationship , or a role/workplace term for Occupation . For Sex , cues are instances of grammatical sex marking, which say nothing about gender identity (Ethical Considerations). A cue is bound to s s when the entity whose attribute it states is s s . The unit is a predication rather than a word: the same pronoun can refer to a protected subject in one sentence and to a clinician in the next, so cues are bound per occurrence.
blocks.zh: 剩余提示是D的(i,j,a)的(i,j,a)的(i,j,a),其表面形式表明某些实体的(a)的属性值:性别的代词或地址形式、关系的关系或婚姻术语,或职业的角色/工作地点术语。 就性而言,提示是语法性标记的事例,其中没有提到性别认同(道德考虑). 当其属性为 s 的实体为 s 时, 提示即为 s 。 单位是预言而非单词:同一代词可以在一句话中指被保护对象,在下一句中指临床医生,所以提示每个发生时都受约束.

blocks.en: The editor returns D ′ D^{\prime} , obtained from D D via edits confined to cue spans and the agreement they disturb. Three requirements define a good edit. Privacy : for every protected pair ( s , a ) (s,a) , an adversary that reads D ′ D^{\prime} and is instructed which person to consider should be closer than on D D to what it would guess without any text, neither more confident in the true value nor steered toward an incorrect one. Utility : content that states no protected attribute of a protected subject should survive. Scope : cues bound to people outside S S , and uses of attribute vocabulary that refer to no person, should not be edited; S S encodes the release policy on whom to protect. The baseline is D D itself, the text the de-identifier already released.
blocks.zh: 编辑器返回 D ' D ' d ' prime , 由 D D 编辑获得, 仅限于提示间距和它们扰乱的协议。 三项要求定义了良好的编辑. 隐私:对于每一个受保护的对子(s, a) (s, a), 一个读 D ' D^{\prime 的对手, 并被指示考虑哪一个人应该比DD上更接近它会猜到的, 没有任何文本, 既不对真实值更有信心, 也不向错误值的方向走去. 效用:规定受保护主体没有受保护属性的内容不应存在。 范围 : 绑定在 S S 之外的人的提示, 以及使用指向任何人的属性词汇, 不应编辑; S S 编码了要保护谁的发布政策. 基线是 D D 本身,即已经发布的去标识符文本 。

blocks.en: SACC (Scoped Attribute-Cue Closure) is shown in Figure 5 and stated in Algorithm 1 . Every step is deterministic; the only learned component is a dependency parser. SACC reads only D D , mention forms, and attribute names, and traces each edit to the cue and rule that triggered it. Two principles shape the editor: closure , which puts the burden of proof on leaving a cue unchanged, and admissibility , which rewrites a cue only to a counterpart that carries no value of any protected attribute (Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: SCAC(缩小属性-Cue关闭)见图5,用算法表示 1 (英语). 每个步骤都是决定性的;唯一学到的知识是依赖解析器。 SACC只读 D D , 提及表单和属性名称, 并追踪每个编辑到触发它的提示和规则 。 两种原则决定了编辑器的形状:关闭,将举证责任放在留下一个提示不变,以及可接受性,它只将提示改写给没有任何保护属性值的对应方(第6节)。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 SACC ( D , S , M , A , P ) (D,S,M,A,P) : the find half (lines 1–4) and the edit half (lines 5–6). Dir , Rel , Unr : direct, relational, unresolved; the other two statuses leave the cue.
blocks.zh: 算法 1 SACC (D, S, M, A, P) (D, S, M, A, P) : find half (第1-4行) 和编辑 half (第5-6行). 迪尔, 瑞尔, unr:直接,关系,未解决;另外两个状态离开提示.

blocks.en: A lexicon of closed lists per attribute and register is matched against the document (Figure 6 prints all patterns). For each match and each protected subject, a binder reads the dependency parse and returns one of five statuses: the cue describes the subject directly; it is a relational term whose possessor is the subject; its referent cannot be resolved; it describes another entity; or it is a non-person use (e.g., a role noun heading an organisation). Closure edits every cue except the last two, so unresolved cues are edited rather than left unchanged; a short keep-list, shared with every editor we compare against, is never edited. Admissibility then rewrites each selected cue only to a counterpart from a closed table whose outputs state no value of any protected attribute, and otherwise redacts it. A repair step re-inflects verbs affected by the rewrites. It has three settings, chosen per corpus (Appendix S ): no repair; light , which rewrites a cue only when its sentence isolates one table entry and otherwise leaves it redacted; and full , which rewrites and repairs nearly every selected cue. Appendix G gives the lexicons, binder rules, keep-list and rewrite table.
blocks.zh: 每个属性和登记册的封闭列表词汇表与文档相匹配(图6打印所有图案)。 对于每个匹配和每个被保护对象,绑定器会读取依赖解析并返回五个状态中的一个:提示直接描述对象;它是一个关系名词,其拥有者是主体;它的引用语不能解决;它描述另一个实体;或者它是非人使用(例如,一个角色名词领导一个组织). 关闭会编辑除最后两个提示以外的每一个提示,所以未解决的提示会被编辑,而不是保持不变;与我们比较的每个编辑共享的简短的保存列表永远不会编辑. 然后,可接受性只将每个选定的提示重写到一个封闭表格的对应方,其输出表示没有任何受保护属性的值,否则将重新编辑。 一个修补步骤重新反映受重写影响的动词. 它有三个设置, 所选的 per acident (Appendix S ) : 不修复; 光线, 只有在句子隔离一个表格条目, 并留下它被修改时, 才重写一个提示; 完整, 几乎每个选定的提示都会重写和修复 。 附 录 G给出词汇,绑定规则,保留列表和重写表格.

blocks.en: Closure is the main design choice that requires justification, because de-identification removes antecedents a binder would otherwise need: 41% of cues edited on MedQA and 90% on TAB have no resolved referent (Table 12 ). Reading the source text, a judge assigns 1,618 of the 1,659 unresolved TAB edit sites (97.5%) to a protected person (Table 16 ), so editing them is correct in almost all cases. The agreement setting is the method’s only tuned parameter, chosen per corpus by five-fold cross-fitting on the development adversary (Appendix S ).
blocks.zh: 关闭是需要说明的主要设计选择,因为去识别可以消除先前的束缚器,否则就需要:在MedQA上编辑的提示有41%,在TAB上编辑的提示有90%没有解答(表12)。 在阅读源文本时,法官将1 659个未解决的TAB编辑站点中的1 618个(97.5%)分配给受保护人(表16),因此几乎所有情况下编辑都是正确的。 协议设定是该方法唯一的调制参数,通过五倍的交叉匹配来选择开发对手(附录S).

blocks.en:
Section 4 reports the construction and its results; this appendix records the design, the pre-specified
predictions and the cost. SWAP is built from the scored SACC-mask text: within every region that SACC-mask replaced, each cue that the binder trace marks as Sex is rewritten to its opposite-sex form ( he / she ; her as his or him , depending on its
dependency role; husband / wife ; and the rest of the 19 sex forms the editor selects), and every other cue is written as [REDACTED] . Thus SWAP and SACC-mask differ only on sex cues; written with [REDACTED] instead, the same
construction reproduces SACC-mask on 99.7% of MedQA and all TAB documents. It was scored by the development adversary

blocks.en: Unlike the text-conditioned checks above, this control uses no document in either prior. The canonical prior uses “Subject A”, whereas the posterior uses the released text’s surviving, cue-free reference. As a check on this question mismatch, we recompute the document-free prior using the posterior’s subject handle. The reference itself can convey information even without the document and can vary by editor; this sensitivity analysis measures how subject-handle wording affects the document-free baseline.

model, leaves upstream placeholders untouched and can run after such an anonymiser (Appendix R ).

ladder: sex cues are rewritten to epicene pronouns and unmarked nouns, with
the verb agreement the pronoun needs, and forms of address are dropped; occupation and relationship cues are replaced by
the first rung above them, a sector term for a role noun or a generic kinship or partnership term for a relational noun,
and are redacted when the ladder has no rung or the cue is negated. A short list of occupational expressions for which
no truthful more general term exists is left in place. The ladder’s sex rewrites are therefore close to SACC’s, while its occupation
and relationship rewrites still name a value of the attribute, which SACC’s admissibility rule does not allow, so SACC redacts those cues.

For U nli U_{\mathrm{nli}} , the allowed sentences are the source sentences of at least 40 characters that contain no protected cue
according to a fixed cue detector that predates SACC’s binder (the subject’s mentions and the attribute lexicon, matched in the
source sentences about the subject);
each is the hypothesis, and the premise is a 1,200-character window of the released text centred on the median
position of the sentence’s rarest content words. The cross-encoder is DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuned for NLI ( He et al., 2023 ) , and a sentence counts as retained when entailment is the argmax. For TPS, edit regions are
the character-level differences between D D and the released text; the information content of an original span is its
negative log-probability under BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) with the span masked and 600 characters of context on
each side, and similarity is the clipped cosine of E5 embeddings ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , which replace the original
metric’s sentence encoder. TPS is averaged over the documents each system edits, on every document of each corpus.
With the original encoder, paraphrase-albert-small-v2, on every MedQA document, SACC’s TPS ties the global ladder’s
(difference − .001 -.001 , 99% interval [ − .004 , + .003 ] [-.004,+.003] ) and stays above every other editor’s by .10 to .16; with E5 it is
above the ladder’s by .004 ( [ + .002 , + .005 ] [+.002,+.005] ). A prediction pre-specified before that pass, that SACC would score
highest with either encoder, therefore failed with the original one.

blocks.en:
The lexicons, rules and the one tuned setting were written on the three evaluation corpora, so we ran the frozen
editor on two corpora it had not seen, each pre-specified in a dated file before its data was read: 500 encyclopaedic biographies
with self-reported profession and gender labels ( De-Arteaga et al., 2019 ) and 500 Wikipedia film plot
summaries whose characters carry a gender label from a knowledge base ( Bamman et al., 2013 ) . Both keep
SACC’s released configuration unchanged: the clinical register’s lexicon, the binder, the full agreement setting
and the shared keep-list, and use a generic spaCy NER as upstream de-identifier with the domain phrase
in the adversary’s prompts adapted for each corpus. The summaries name their characters, so the binder
receives mention forms as the task defines them; the biographies name no one, so it does not.
Table 39 gives the result.

拥有自报职业和性别标签(De-Arteaga等人,2019年)和500部维基百科电影情节
Bamman等人,2013年。 都留着
SACC的释放配置不变:临床登记簿的词典、绑定器、协议的全部设定
和共享的保存列表, 并使用通用的温泉 Cy NER 作为带有域词组的上游去识别符
在敌方的提示中, 适应每个事件。 简表上写着他们的字符,所以绑定器
作为任务的定义,接受提及表格; 传记中不给任何人起名,所以没有。
表39给出了结果。

blocks.en:
The main result transfers. SACC lowers its input’s leakage on both corpora, and admissible rewriting stays more
private than redaction ( − .016 -.016 and − .037 -.037 ). It edits the fewest characters of any system on both, 1.6% against
the global ladder’s 1.9% and 2.8%, and on the biographies, where the content measures ran, it keeps more at the
edit site than the ladder (TPS + .013 +.013 [ + .011 , + .015 ] [+.011,+.015] ). Occupation does not transfer: the biographies’
profession measure moves by .004, the reach of an occupation lexicon written for two other registers. One gate
failed: the NER layer masks 25% of the biographies’ characters against 12% of the summaries’, so on that corpus
the content comparison with the input is compromised, and U nli U_{\mathrm{nli}} , whose sentences come from the source,
sits at its floor for every system there.

blocks.en:
Three LLM judges read 180 items drawn from a sample fixed in advance (60 per corpus), each a passage with one of its
subjects and the propositions it states, on the released texts. They judge which of the propositions a text still states
(81 passages with reference facts) and whether an edited passage carries a grammatical or fluency fault (140 to 145
passages). GPT-4.1 was designated the primary judge before any output: it is the strongest judge in our configuration and
the only one that is neither an adversary nor the LLM rewrite’s model. GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3-30B-A3B are reported
beside it, and no per-item majority is formed. Each judge also reads the unedited input as a control: on it, a valid
judge keeps at least .70 of the reference facts and no fewer than on an edited text, and flags the original words at
SACC’s edit positions no more often than the edits themselves. Table 60 gives the levels.

edit positions about as often as SACC’s rewrites (.241 against .257), and twice as often as the redactions, so its

use: on MedQA and TAB, 36 of its 60 agreement flags pair they with a plural verb and none pairs it with a singular

blocks.en:
Automatic content scores do not see grammaticality, and two of three LLM judges failed their controls
(Appendix T ), so people judged passages around SACC’s edits. Thirty MedQA and thirty TAB documents on
which SACC’s text differs from the global ladder’s were drawn with a fixed seed; from each, one of SACC’s edit
sites was drawn, and the input sentence holding it, with one sentence on each side (at most 120 words), was aligned to
SACC’s, SACC-mask’s and the global ladder’s text. Annotators saw the input passage and the three versions in a random
order, with the words that differ listed, never a system name or score, and labelled each version on two scales: Facts , whether it still states all (2), some (1) or little (0) of the input’s content, where losing a word that
only states a person’s sex, relationship status or occupation counts as no loss; and Grammar , no error (3), a minor
error (2) or an error that hinders reading (1), where singular they with plural agreement counts as grammatical.
One passage in seven was an instructed attention check, and every annotator passed all of them. Three volunteers,
fluent in English and not involved in this work, annotated the passages after reading the guidelines summarised here.
They were recruited personally by one of the authors from outside the project and were not paid. Each passage was labelled by all three, and contrasts are paired by passage with two-sided 95%
cluster-bootstrap intervals; agreement is Krippendorff’s α \alpha ( Krippendorff, 2004 ) . The tests fixed before
annotation were that SACC keeps more Facts than the global ladder and than SACC-mask, and that its Grammar is non-inferior to SACC-mask’s at a margin of 0.2. The passages were labelled in two halves of thirty;
each half was first analysed with two annotators, and the third annotator’s labels, added afterwards, change no test’s
outcome.

blocks.en:
Table 65 summarises the mean ratings and paired differences. SACC preserves more content than the global ladder,
with the largest improvements on MedQA, and achieves higher grammaticality on both corpora. Annotators primarily attribute
content loss under the ladder to over-generalised non-person nouns (e.g., clinic → \rightarrow workplace , army → \rightarrow public servant ) and the resulting degraded noun phrases. Compared to SACC-mask, rewriting retains
slightly more information (separable on MedQA, not on TAB) but is marginally less
grammatical, so it fails the pre-specified non-inferiority test. The remaining errors are mostly agreement issues
(e.g., occasional singular verbs following they ), which do not arise under redaction.
blocks.zh:
表65概述了平均评级和对等差异。 SACC保存的内容超过全球阶梯,
与MedQA的最大改进, 并实现更高的语法 在两个公司。 主要属性
内容损失在过度普遍化的非人名名词的阶梯下(例如诊所 \\\\ 右翼工作场所,军队 \\ 右翼公务员),并由此退化的名词短语. 与 SACC 任务相比, 重写保留
稍多一些信息(在医疗质量评估上分开,而不是在TAB上分开),但略少一些
语法上,因此它未能通过预先指定的非任意性测试. 其余错误主要是协议问题
(例如,不定期的单数动词跟随它们),这些动词在编辑下不会出现.
